2.3.35 Report.ReportParametersLayout
Applies to RDL 2016/01
The Report.ReportParametersLayout element specifies element information of a report parameter
layout for a Report. This element MUST be specified if the Report.ReportParameters element is
specified. This element is of type ReportParametersLayout.
Following is the parent element of the Report.ReportParametersLayout element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.ReportParametersLayout element.
 <xsd:element name="ReportParametersLayout" type="ReportParametersLayoutType" minOccurs="0" />
